where: Section 3 (VLAD paragraph) and section heading 'a compact variant'
problem: VLAD is called 'compact', but the chapter itself says its vector has length k·d, which is 128 times longer than the k-length BoVW histogram it is compared with. A student will read 'compact' as 'shorter than BoVW' and then meet a number that contradicts it.
fix: Say instead: 'VLAD is a richer extension that keeps more than counts: it stores a d-dimensional correction per word, so its vector is k·d long (128 times longer than the plain histogram) but far more discriminative per image.'

problem: The claim 'The entries sum to 1' silently assumes the image gave at least one descriptor. A blank or very smooth image can detect zero keypoints, and then N = 0 and the division is undefined.
fix: Add one sentence: 'If an image yields no descriptors (N = 0), the histogram is undefined; either fall back to an all-zero vector or reject the image.'
